## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit (`feat(api): …`, `fix(web): …`). It becomes the squash commit and drives the release.
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] `just lint` and `just test-unit` pass locally
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, `README.md`, `contracts/`) if behaviour, commands or the message contract changed
- [ ] Breaking change? Title has `!` and the description explains the migration
